title: Challenged myself to build a game every 2 weeks - here's Game 3!
author: Intelligent-Field-80
selftext:
This one is a cozy light switching puzzle inspired by my recent move to New York (who else is here?!). It's truly a city that that never sleeps and decided to make a game for it with iconic New York architecture.

It was an interesting challenge to build the modular buildings where I could easily switch elements like the colors, tile styles, roof, ground level etc. to make new levels fast, as well as increment the difficulty by adding more floors. Wondering if that could be a useful skill or MCP to build?

You can find this game and the previous two games - a movie emoji trivia puzzle and a new twist on shmups - in [fiveminutegames.net](http://fiveminutegames.net/) ! All games are free, no ads - just trying to learn what works, what doesn't and what do people like.

Comment if you have any feedback or also putting yourself through a game jam!
